info.name: YNAB API — Operator
info.description:
Human-facing operational collection for the YNAB API as consumed by ynab-mcp.

Use this collection to:
- Discover what routes exist and what they return
- Manually explore a budget and inspect live data
- Debug tool failures by isolating the underlying API call
- Verify authentication and plan-id configuration

Authentication: All requests require a YNAB Personal Access Token (PAT).
Set `api_key` in your active Postman environment.

Amounts: YNAB stores all monetary values in milliunits (1000 = $1.00).

Delta sync: Many list endpoints accept `last_knowledge_of_server`.
Save the `server_knowledge` value from any response and pass it back
to fetch only changed records since that point.

Safety: Requests tagged [WRITE] create or modify durable data.
Read requests are safe to run at any time.

item.name: User
item.description: Verify the authenticated identity of the PAT being used.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns the user object associated with the current PAT.
Useful for verifying that the API key is valid before running
other requests. A 401 here means the api_key variable is wrong
or the PAT has been revoked.

Key fields: id, username.

item.name: Plans
item.description:
A "plan" is what YNAB calls a "budget." All budget-scoped routes
require a plan_id. Set the `plan_id` environment variable to avoid
pasting it into every request.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns all budgets accessible to the authenticated user.
Run this first to find your plan_id. Copy it into the `plan_id`
environment variable so other requests can use it via {{plan_id}}.

Key fields: data.budgets[].id, data.budgets[].name,
data.budgets[].last_modified_on.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

query.description: Omit for full fetch. Pass saved server_knowledge for delta sync.

request.description:
Returns a single plan with all embedded data: accounts, categories,
months, payees, and transactions. This is a heavy response.

Pass `last_knowledge_of_server` to request only changes since the
last fetch — the server returns `server_knowledge` you can use
in the next call.

Key fields: data.budget.id, data.budget.name,
data.budget.currency_format, data.server_knowledge.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

query.description: Server knowledge from a previous response.

request.description:
Same as Get Plan Detail but demonstrates delta sync usage.
Set last_knowledge_of_server to a previously saved server_knowledge
value. The response contains only data that changed since that point.
Save the new server_knowledge from the response for the next call.

Use this pattern when polling for changes to avoid full budget downloads.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns currency format and date format settings for the plan.
Use this to determine how to format amounts and dates when displaying
data to a user. The currency_format.iso_code field gives the ISO
currency code (e.g. USD, EUR).

Key fields: data.settings.date_format.format,
data.settings.currency_format.iso_code,
data.settings.currency_format.symbol.

item.name: Accounts
item.description:
Accounts represent bank accounts, credit cards, loans, and assets
tracked within a plan. Balances are in milliunits.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

query.description: Delta sync — omit for full list.

request.description:
Returns all accounts for the plan. Includes balance, cleared_balance,
uncleared_balance, and account type. Closed accounts are included
unless filtered. Supports delta sync.

Key fields: data.accounts[].id, data.accounts[].name,
data.accounts[].type, data.accounts[].balance,
data.accounts[].transfer_payee_id (needed for transfer transactions).

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns a single account by ID. Useful for inspecting the
transfer_payee_id of a specific account — needed when creating
transfer transactions via the transactions API.

Key fields: data.account.id, data.account.name, data.account.balance,
data.account.transfer_payee_id, data.account.direct_import_linked.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Creates a new account. Note: this creates a durable account in YNAB.
Choose account_type carefully — it cannot be changed after creation.

account_type values: checking, savings, creditCard, cash, lineOfCredit,
otherAsset, otherLiability, mortgage, autoLoan, studentLoan, personalLoan,
medicalDebt, otherDebt.

balance: opening balance in milliunits.

item.name: Categories
item.description:
Categories organize spending. They live inside category groups.
Each category tracks budgeted, activity (spending), and balance.
Goal-related fields track funding targets.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

query.description: Delta sync — omit for full list.

request.description:
Returns all categories grouped by category group. The response
structure is data.category_groups[].categories[]. Use this to
map category names to IDs for downstream requests.

Key fields: data.category_groups[].id,
data.category_groups[].categories[].id,
data.category_groups[].categories[].name,
data.category_groups[].categories[].budgeted,
data.category_groups[].categories[].activity,
data.category_groups[].categories[].balance.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns a single category. Includes the current month's budgeted,
activity, and balance values. Also includes goal fields if a funding
target is set: goal_type, goal_target, goal_percentage_complete,
goal_under_funded.

Key fields: data.category.id, data.category.name,
data.category.budgeted, data.category.balance,
data.category.goal_type, data.category.goal_under_funded.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns a category's values as of a specific month. Use this to
inspect historical budgeted/activity/balance data rather than
current-month values.

month: ISO date string for the first day of the month (e.g. 2025-01-01).

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Set the budgeted amount for a category in a specific month.
This is the primary way to allocate money in YNAB.

budgeted: amount in milliunits (1000 = $1.00).
month: first day of the target month, e.g. 2025-05-01.

Note: this modifies the plan's budget allocation. The change
is reflected immediately in the YNAB web app.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Update a category's name, note, or goal settings.
Only include fields you want to change — omitted fields are unchanged.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Create a new category inside an existing category group.
category_group_id is required.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Create a new category group. Category groups organize categories
into logical sections (e.g. "Fixed Expenses", "Savings Goals").

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Update a category group's name or hidden status.
Note: YNAB does not support deleting category groups directly.

item.name: Months
item.description:
Month data includes summary-level budget information (to_be_budgeted,
income, activity) and optionally the full category list for that month.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns summary data for all months that have budget activity.
Use this to see a timeline of the budget and navigate to specific
months. Ordered newest-first.

Key fields: data.months[].month (ISO date),
data.months[].to_be_budgeted, data.months[].income,
data.months[].budgeted, data.months[].activity.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns full month data including all categories with their
budgeted/activity/balance values for that month.

month: ISO date for the first day of the month (e.g. 2025-05-01),
or the string "current" for the current month.

Key fields: data.month.to_be_budgeted, data.month.age_of_money,
data.month.categories[].budgeted, data.month.categories[].balance.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Convenience alias for the current month. Returns the same shape
as Get Month Detail. Use this when you don't know the current
month's ISO date or want to avoid computing it.

item.name: Transactions — Read
item.description:
Transaction read endpoints. All amounts are in milliunits.
Negative amounts are outflows (spending); positive are inflows (income).
Split transactions have subtransactions[]; transfer transactions have
transfer_account_id and transfer_transaction_id set.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

query.description: Only return transactions on or after this ISO date.
Delta sync — omit for full list.

request.description:
Returns all transactions for the plan, newest first.
This can be a large response for mature budgets.
Use since_date or last_knowledge_of_server to limit the response.

Key fields: data.transactions[].id, data.transactions[].date,
data.transactions[].amount, data.transactions[].payee_name,
data.transactions[].category_name, data.transactions[].cleared,
data.transactions[].approved, data.transactions[].deleted.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
List only transactions with no category assigned.
Useful for triage workflows — find all transactions that need
a category before closing out the month.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
List only transactions that are imported but not yet approved.
Useful for review workflows — imported bank transactions show as
unapproved until confirmed in YNAB.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

query.description: ISO date. Only transactions on or after this date.

request.description:
List transactions on or after a specific date.
More efficient than fetching all transactions when you only need
recent activity. Useful for monthly review workflows.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
List transactions for a specific account. Useful for reconciliation
or inspecting spending on a particular credit card.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
List all transactions assigned to a specific category.
Useful for reviewing spending in a category or auditing
a category's recent activity.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
List all transactions for a specific payee.
Useful for reviewing spending at a particular merchant or
generating a history for a recurring payee.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
List all transactions for a specific month.
month: ISO date for the first day of the month (e.g. 2025-05-01).

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Get a single transaction by ID. Includes the full subtransactions
array for split transactions. Check transfer_account_id to
determine if this is one side of a transfer.

Key fields: data.transaction.id, data.transaction.amount,
data.transaction.subtransactions[], data.transaction.transfer_account_id.

item.name: Transactions — Write
item.description:
Write operations for transactions. These create or modify durable data in YNAB.
All amounts must be in milliunits (1000 = $1.00).
Negative amounts are outflows (spending); positive are inflows (income).

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Create a single transaction. All provided fields are saved.

amount: milliunits. Negative for outflow (spending), positive for inflow.
cleared: "cleared", "uncleared", or "reconciled".
approved: if false, the transaction appears as pending in YNAB.

For transfers: set payee_id to the transfer_payee_id of the target
account (found in the accounts list). Do not set payee_name.

For splits: include subtransactions[] where amounts sum to the parent
amount. Each subtransaction can have its own category_id and memo.

import_id: optional dedup key. If a transaction with the same
import_id already exists, this request is silently skipped.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Create a split transaction where a single purchase is divided across
multiple categories. The subtransactions amounts must sum exactly to
the parent amount. Each subtransaction can have its own category_id
and memo.

Example: $50 Target purchase split between Groceries ($30) and
Household ($20). Parent amount: -50000. Sub amounts: -30000 + -20000.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Replace a transaction's fields. All provided fields are updated.
Omit fields you want to leave unchanged. This is a full replacement
of the transaction's editable fields — not a partial patch.

amount: milliunits.
account_id and date are required.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Update multiple transactions in a single call. Each entry in
transactions[] must include `id`. Other fields are optional —
only provided fields are updated.

IMPORTANT: This is NOT atomic. The response contains:
- transaction_ids: successfully updated IDs
- duplicate_import_ids: skipped due to duplicate import_id

Always verify the response counts rather than assuming all-or-nothing.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Delete a transaction. This is permanent — deleted transactions
are soft-deleted (deleted: true) but cannot be easily recovered.

WARNING: For transfer transactions, deleting one side also affects
the paired transaction on the other account. Always check
transfer_account_id before deleting. If transfer_account_id is set,
fetch the paired transaction first to understand the full impact.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Trigger YNAB's built-in import from linked bank accounts.
This does NOT accept external transaction data or file uploads.
Only accounts with a direct bank link (direct_import_linked: true)
are affected.

Returns the IDs of transactions that were imported.
Safe to call multiple times — already-imported transactions are skipped.

item.name: Payees
item.description:
Payees are merchants, people, or sources that transactions are
attributed to. YNAB creates payees automatically from imported
transactions. The transfer_payee_id on accounts is used to create
transfer transactions.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns all payees for the plan. Use this to find payee IDs for
filtering transactions or for creating transfer transactions
(using the account's transfer_payee_id).

Key fields: data.payees[].id, data.payees[].name,
data.payees[].transfer_account_id (non-null for transfer payees).

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: Returns a single payee by ID.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Create a new payee. Added in YNAB API v1.81.0 (March 2026).
Useful for pre-seeding payees before creating transactions.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Rename a payee. Note: renaming a payee renames it for all
existing transactions that reference it.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns geographic location data (latitude/longitude) for payees
imported from bank feeds. Low priority for most workflows.
Location data is set by the bank, not by the user.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: Get a single payee location by ID.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: List all geographic locations for a specific payee.

item.name: Scheduled Transactions
item.description:
Scheduled transactions are recurring entries that YNAB generates
automatically. They are used for recurring bills, subscriptions, and
planned transfers. They become real transactions when their date arrives.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns all scheduled transactions. Use this to see upcoming
recurring bills, subscription charges, and planned transfers.

Key fields: data.scheduled_transactions[].id,
data.scheduled_transactions[].date_next (next occurrence),
data.scheduled_transactions[].frequency,
data.scheduled_transactions[].amount,
data.scheduled_transactions[].payee_name,
data.scheduled_transactions[].category_name.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: Get a single scheduled transaction including subtransactions.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Create a recurring scheduled transaction.

frequency values: never, daily, weekly, everyOtherWeek, twiceAMonth,
every4Weeks, monthly, everyOtherMonth, every3Months, every4Months,
twiceAYear, yearly, everyOtherYear.

amount: milliunits (negative for outflow).
date_first: ISO date for the first occurrence.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Replace a scheduled transaction's fields. All editable fields
are replaced with the provided values.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Delete a scheduled transaction. This stops the recurring entry
and removes all future scheduled occurrences.
Past transactions that were already generated are unaffected.

item.name: Money Movements
item.description:
Money movements provide a view of how money flows between category groups.
This is an enriched view not available in the base transaction list.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description:
Returns money movement summary across all months.
Useful for understanding aggregate flows between categories.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: Returns money movements for a specific month.

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: Returns money movements grouped by category group.

item.name: List Money Movement Groups for Month

header.description: YNAB Personal Access Token. Set api_key in your environment.

request.description: Returns money movement groups for a specific month.

variable.description: YNAB API base URL. Do not change unless testing a mock.
Default budget/plan ID. Copy from List Plans response.
Second account ID, used for transfer requests.
Second category ID, used for split transaction requests.
Category group ID for category group requests.
Payee location ID for location requests.
ISO date for the first day of the month, e.g. 2025-05-01.
Save server_knowledge from any response; pass it back for delta sync.
